annotations.title: Start checkout for a paid upgrade

description: Optional: a Stripe link for your human to pay for a 24-hour fast-track or a Featured placement. Call only after the user asked for the upgrade and agreed to its terms (termsUrl from the upgrades list); pass its termsVersion as acceptTerms. Returns a checkoutUrl the user opens to pay. Nothing is charged by this tool.

acceptTerms.description: The upgrade's termsVersion, sent only after the user agrees to the terms.

bot.description: featured-*: share link or directory slug of the listed Bot.

email.description: The user's email for the Stripe receipt and this order.

offer.description: fasttrack-listing for an unlisted Bot; featured-7d or featured-30d for a listed one.

shareUrl.description: fasttrack-listing: the Bot's x.ai share link.

name: start_checkout
